name: Kick Up Beginner Training Program
description: A beginner-friendly progression for learning the kick-up with mobility, bridge strength, core control, and safe explosive practice.

exercises.name: Tuck Roll Back
exercises.description: Practice rolling backward with a rounded spine and tucked chin to learn safe momentum control.
exercises.execution_notes: Roll back smoothly, keep your chin tucked, and return to the start with control.

exercises.name: Shoulder Bridge Hold
exercises.description: Build extension and shoulder support for the kick-up.
exercises.execution_notes: Place hands near your ears, lift hips and chest, and hold a stable bridge position.

exercises.name: Bridge Push
exercises.description: Explode lightly through the shoulders and arms from a bridge position.
exercises.execution_notes: From bridge, press the floor away and create a small lift without collapsing the elbows.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust Kick
exercises.description: Coordinate a quick leg drive with hip extension to build kick-up timing.
exercises.execution_notes: Kick one or both legs upward fast, then reset before the next rep.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.description: Strengthen core tension for better control during the kick-up.
exercises.execution_notes: Press your lower back into the floor, keep ribs down, and hold a tight shape.

exercises.name: Wall Kick-Up
exercises.description: Practice kicking up to a wall to learn alignment and control.
exercises.execution_notes: Kick one leg up, bring the second leg with control, and tap the wall lightly without crashing.

exercises.name: Floor Kick-Up Attempt
exercises.description: Attempt the full kick-up from the floor with controlled timing and a soft landing.
exercises.execution_notes: Start low, kick fast, push through the shoulders, and land softly in a squat or stable stand.
